about.title: A clinic that treats the whole family gently
body: Sai Clinic sits on Ramachandran Nagar Rd in Vasuki Nagar, Tharapakkam — a neighbourhood where the same family often brings in three generations across a single week. That shapes everything about how we practice.

An elderly parent managing blood pressure needs a different kind of patience than a toddler with a fever, and both deserve a doctor who isn't watching the clock. So consultations here are unhurried by design — enough time to actually listen, explain things simply, and make sure nobody leaves with unanswered questions.
Whether it's a routine checkup, a child's first clinic visit, or ongoing care for a chronic condition, our approach stays the same: calm, clear, and genuinely attentive.

blogPosts.title: Caring for Three Generations Under One Roof — What We've Learned
blogPosts.excerpt: Treating grandparents, parents, and children from the same family teaches you that 'unhurried' means something different for every age. Here's what that looks like in practice.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Meenakshi Sundaram
content: In a neighbourhood like Tharapakkam, it's common for us to see three generations of the same family walk through our door across a single week — a grandmother for her blood pressure check, her daughter for a stomach bug, and a grandchild for a routine vaccination.

What we've learned over the years is that 'unhurried care' doesn't mean the same thing for every patient. An elderly patient often needs time to describe symptoms in their own words, without being cut off. A small child needs time simply to feel safe in the room before any examination starts. A working parent needs the visit itself to be quick, even if the conversation within it isn't rushed.

So rather than treating every visit the same way, we've built our approach around reading what each patient — and each age — actually needs. That might mean an extra five minutes of conversation with an elder, or letting a toddler hold the stethoscope before we use it.

None of this requires anything fancy. It just requires deciding, as a clinic, that going a little slower is worth it. That's the whole philosophy behind Sai Clinic, and it's one we intend to keep however much the practice grows.
